# Debrief: Istio, Envoy

These clips cover Istio's evolution from Envoy sidecars to ambient mode with Ztunnel, plus production lessons from GitHub, Bloomberg and Spotify on running Istio and Envoy at scale and extending Envoy. ([Evolution or Revolution: Istio as the Network Platform for Cloud Native · 4:24](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4K6s5y8HoBc&t=264s); [Evolution or Revolution: Istio as the Network Platform for Cloud Native · 13:08](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4K6s5y8HoBc&t=788s); [Istio in Production: Expected Value, Results, and Effort at GitHub Scale · 21:18](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2fXwQylR2lw&t=1278s); [Inside Spotify’s Envoy Architecture: What We Learned the Hard Way · 1:05](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CAn22mnA6kE&t=65s))

## Top 3 takeaways

1. Ambient mesh replaces per-pod Envoy sidecars with a per-node Rust Ztunnel handling L4 routing and mTLS, offering higher throughput, lower latency and easier upgrades, since sidecars required restarting every pod to upgrade. ([Evolution or Revolution: Istio as the Network Platform for Cloud Native · 4:24](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4K6s5y8HoBc&t=264s); [Evolution or Revolution: Istio as the Network Platform for Cloud Native · 13:08](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4K6s5y8HoBc&t=788s))
2. Moving to ambient has costs: tooling such as Argo Rollouts needs the Gateway API plugin, and cert-manager needs an experimental feature enabled, which the speakers called an ugly part of the migration. ([The Good, The Ugly, and The Bad: Leaving Sidecars Behind with Istio Ambient Mesh · 21:59](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ToKv7JntLvY&t=1319s))
3. At large scale, a mesh must be treated as a product for human users rather than raw YAML, and teams do best collaborating with the Istio community and vendors; ambient multicluster just reached beta. ([Istio in Production: Expected Value, Results, and Effort at GitHub Scale · 21:18](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2fXwQylR2lw&t=1278s))

## Action items

- [ ] Audit your rollout and certificate tooling (Argo Rollouts, cert-manager) for Gateway API plugin and experimental-flag requirements before planning an ambient migration. ([The Good, The Ugly, and The Bad: Leaving Sidecars Behind with Istio Ambient Mesh · 21:59](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ToKv7JntLvY&t=1319s))
- [ ] Evaluate Ztunnel on a test cluster, comparing throughput, latency and upgrade effort against your current Envoy sidecars, and check how it fits your CNI. ([Evolution or Revolution: Istio as the Network Platform for Cloud Native · 13:08](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4K6s5y8HoBc&t=788s); [Evolution or Revolution: Istio as the Network Platform for Cloud Native · 4:24](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4K6s5y8HoBc&t=264s))
- [ ] Prototype a Gateway API based traffic shift, both at ingress and between services internally, as GitHub is doing with Istio. ([Istio in Production: Expected Value, Results, and Effort at GitHub Scale · 4:12](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2fXwQylR2lw&t=252s); [Istio in Production: Expected Value, Results, and Effort at GitHub Scale · 21:18](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2fXwQylR2lw&t=1278s))

## Watch together (9 min)

1. [Evolution or Revolution: Istio as the Network Platform for Cloud Native · 4:24](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4K6s5y8HoBc&t=264s) (1:25), Mitch Connors, Daniel Grimm: Explains why sidecars gave way to Ztunnel and ambient.
2. [The Good, The Ugly, and The Bad: Leaving Sidecars Behind with Istio Ambient Mesh · 21:59](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ToKv7JntLvY&t=1319s) (1:21), Alfonso Ming, Jorge Turrado: Candid ambient migration pain points with Argo Rollouts and cert-manager.
3. [Istio in Production: Expected Value, Results, and Effort at GitHub Scale · 21:18](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2fXwQylR2lw&t=1278s) (2:18), Mitch Connors, Golnaz Rouhi: GitHub-scale lessons and ambient multicluster status.
4. [Evolution or Revolution: Istio as the Network Platform for Cloud Native · 13:08](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4K6s5y8HoBc&t=788s) (1:19), Mitch Connors, Daniel Grimm: Ztunnel performance and CNI integration such as Calico.
5. [Envoy in the Era of Agentic Workloads · 19:48](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=HvX4nGkhfZw&t=1188s) (2:25), Yan Avlasov, Erica Hughberg: Advice on extending Envoy via dynamic modules and external processing.
